name: navigation
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished transparent fantasy ARPG icon atlas with exactly TWO equally spaced square cells, ONE ROW and TWO COLUMNS. First: home camp return, a warm illuminated adventurer canvas tent, short wooden sign and small ember campfire, instantly readable at 32px, teal cloth and warm gold details matching fantasy UI. Second: achievement, a finely polished gold medal with cyan faceted center star and two small laurel branches, clear broad silhouette at 32px. Rich material shading, crisp highlights and clean cutout alpha. Entire background genuinely transparent. No circular black disk, no dark halo, no enclosing frame, no text, no letters. Objects individually fit inside each square cell with 8 percent transparent padding, no overlap.
